{"reply": "Thanks, Jeffrey, you're verified. I've sent a warranty review request for the yellow car-with-squiggly-lines light. Your claim number is WC-5EB4CD. It's a request, not an approval. The warranty desk decides after an inspection. I also created a second request by mistake, WC-2D62F1. Please ignore it, as it's a duplicate and I've flagged it for the team.

Here is where your coverage stands. Your basic coverage (3 years / 60,000 km) and powertrain coverage (5 years / 100,000 km) are past their limits. Corrosion coverage (7 years) is still active.

Your Halden also has an open safety recall, NM-24R01: the rear camera image may not display. The fix is a software update of about 45 minutes, at no cost to you, and parts are available.

Would you like to book an inspection and the recall update at our Oakville branch?", "action": "drafted_claim", "escalation_reason": "none", "summary": "Claim WC-5EB4CD was submitted for a yellow stability/traction-control style warning light on a 2021 Halden (123,809 km). I also sent a duplicate claim, WC-2D62F1, by mistake with placeholder text as the symptom. Please close or void WC-2D62F1. The customer was told about the duplicate and was not promised coverage. Open recall NM-24R01 was mentioned, and the customer may want to book at Oakville.", "policy_rules_cited": ["P-01", "P-03", "P-04"]}
